harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Separated node2 (VLAN 10) and node3 (VLAN 20) onto their own VLANs over the shared link (eth1/enp8s0), with node1 (VyOS) routing between them via 802.1Q sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24). node2 got a systemd-networkd VLAN device vlan10 (10.10.10.11/24) on enp8s0; node3 got vlan20 (10.10.20.12/24) on enp8s0; each with a static route to the other's subnet via node1. Verified end-to-end ping between node2 and node3 (TTL=63, confirming a routed hop through node1). Config persists via VyOS `save` and systemd-networkd unit files. Completed the mandatory restart-evidence protocol: captured boot_id baselines on all three nodes, restarted each node one at a time, confirmed each boot_id changed, and re-verified VLAN interfaces, routes, and cross-VLAN connectivity post-restart on all nodes.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes (OS, interfaces, routing) — identified VyOS on node1, Ubuntu 24.04 on node2/node3, and the shared second NIC (eth1/enp8s0) as the unconfigured trunk link
Confirmed VyOS firewall had no rulesets (default forwarding allowed)
Configured VyOS node1 with 802.1Q vif sub-interfaces eth1.10 (10.10.10.1/24) and eth1.20 (10.10.20.1/24); committed and saved
Configured node2 with a systemd-networkd VLAN netdev (vlan10, tag 10) bound to enp8s0, static IP 10.10.10.11/24, and a static route to 10.10.20.0/24 via 10.10.10.1
Configured node3 with a systemd-networkd VLAN netdev (vlan20, tag 20) bound to enp8s0, static IP 10.10.20.12/24, and a static route to 10.10.10.0/24 via 10.10.20.1
Restarted systemd-networkd on node2/node3 to apply VLAN config; verified interfaces and routes
Verified end-to-end cross-VLAN ping between node2 and node3 (TTL=63, routed via node1)
Captured boot_id baselines on node1/node2/node3
Restarted node1 (VyOS reboot), polled until back, confirmed boot_id changed, verified VLAN config persisted and connectivity restored
Restarted node2 (reboot), polled until back, confirmed boot_id changed, verified VLAN config and connectivity restored
Restarted node3 (reboot), polled until back, confirmed boot_id changed, verified VLAN config and connectivity restored

evidence.requirement: Cross-VLAN connectivity between node2 and node3 through node1
evidence.summary: Successful pings both directions between node2 (10.10.10.11) and node3 (10.10.20.12) with TTL=63 confirming a routed hop through node1

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health and boot identity before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 4098161f-de60-45f0-8b5b-25aff0b44274 and interface health prior to restart

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered state
evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; connection reset confirmed reboot in progress; boot_id changed to 3929bb1a-1bd8-4c7b-bee0-ed1e49f0bbde; VLAN sub-interfaces and IPs present post-reboot (persisted via save); cross-VLAN ping from node2 succeeded post-recovery

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to 758e183f-e4c9-404a-83fe-9db5f9d25311; vlan10 interface, routes, and successful cross-VLAN ping to node3 confirmed post-reboot

evidence.summary: Reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; boot_id changed to 472edf6a-8029-4757-b018-14a57b390d66; vlan20 interface, routes, and successful bidirectional cross-VLAN ping confirmed post-reboot
